text:
aj: Heads-up — our PR gating evals are queuing on GH Actions self-hosted runners and causing flaky PR blocks.
ci-bot: automated alert: 3 workflow runs failed in last 30m: runner_timeout (10m), job_canceled (2)
maria: saw this too, looks like the matrix is huge for quantization PRs (+30 shards)
samir: we hit runner concurrency caps, runner pool is saturated by nightly shards
aj: logs:
```
2024-08-18T14:12:03Z job=eval-shard-12 status=timeout waiting_for_runner
queue_depth=18 active_runners=4
```
olivia: can we reduce matrix or change strategy to `matrix: include` -> smaller shards?
leo: alternative: set `concurrency: group` on gha workflow + add `runs-on: [self-hosted, eval]` split by label
maria: buildkite option would let us reuse runner pools, but needs onboarding time
samir: immediate fix: add jitter to PR gating schedule + decrease parallel shards in PRs to 6
devx: propose workflow patch:
```
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.ref }}-eval
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  eval:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include: # split heavy tests into fewer shards for PRs
```
aj: i'll open a small PR with matrix=6 for PR workflow and add alerts if queue_depth > 10 :thumbsup:
maria: +1, and let's track p95 queue time in the eval dashboard
ci-bot: ticket created: EVALS-482 (auto) — will post run stats
aj: thanks — rolling out change now, will update once merged
